description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the DetectVideoLivingFace operation
description_zh: 本文介绍视频活体检测DetectVideoLivingFace的语法及示例
name: DetectVideoLivingFace

parameters.description_en: The URL of the input video that contains the face to be detected. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
parameters.description_zh: 输入待检测人脸的视频URL。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见[文件URL处理](~~155645~~)。
parameters.help_en: The URL of the input video that contains the face to be detected. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 输入待检测人脸的视频URL。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
